'''2000 DecipherCon Death Star II Closed Environment''' was a Star Wars CCG closed-environment side event at [[DecipherCon 2000]] (5–8 October 2000, Kissimmee, Florida). Decipher's DecipherCon 2000 event list calls it "Death Star II Closed Environment Constructed" (sanctioned, 4 games) and ran it three times: Thursday 5 October at 5 p.m. (#SW113), Friday 6 October at 4 p.m. (#SW123) and Saturday 7 October at 11 a.m. (#SW132), as "this new tournament environment".<ref name="dcon-sw-events">[http://www.decipher.com/deciphercon/2000/events/starwarsccg.html Star Wars Customizable Card Game events], DecipherCon 2000, Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010126213800/http://www.decipher.com/deciphercon/2000/events/starwarsccg.html Internet Archive].</ref> [[Andy McClure]] won a Jedi Luke shirt with an Endor and Death Star II Dark deck that went 4–0; which of the three sessions he played is not recorded.<ref name="dt-11172">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11172 The Emperor's Little Buddies (Closed Environment deck)], DeckTech (Andy "Solo337" McClure, 15 October 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/11172/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/11172/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018105122/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11172/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 5–8 October 2000
* '''Site:''' Doubletree Resort, Kissimmee, Florida
* '''Format:''' [[Death Star II Closed Environment]] (Decipher's name; the Players Committee calls it the Battle of Endor Environment)
* '''Sessions:''' three scheduled (5, 6 and 7 October), 4 games each; no source says whether all three were played

== Card pool ==

Decks used only [[Endor (expansion)|Endor]] and [[Death Star II (expansion)|Death Star II]] cards plus the other cards printed in the [[Death Star II Starter Decks]]; see [[Death Star II Closed Environment]] for the full pool.<ref name="afg">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Alternate-Formats-Guide.pdf Star Wars CCG Alternate Format Tournament Guide] (revised 09/2015), Players Committee. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195355/https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Alternate-Formats-Guide.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

Decipher gave a Jedi Luke shirt as the prize for winning a DecipherCon 2000 side event: [[Brian Terwilliger]] won one by going 4–0 in a Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck event.<ref name="tr-d1331">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-12-twigg-at-d-con-2kd1331/ twigg-at-d-con-2k], DeckTech (Brian "twigg" Terwilliger, 12 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-12-twigg-at-d-con-2kd1331/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
